reviews.x: Obviously Olaplex is a great system in general - this kit is specific is an AMAZING buy, great starter kit if you haven’t tried Olaplex before. I have shoulder length curly 3b/3c African American hair and I got about 3 complete uses out of this kit! Can’t beat this for under $30 - you usually get only one full sized product for about that price. This is a great way to try the basic system without spending a lot. I wish it included some of their leave-in products.

reviews.t: My Hairdresser HIGHLY recommended, and I am Grateful !

reviews.t: affordable way to try out Olaplex
reviews.x: I really wanted to try Olaplex and see if it was worth the price and and good as the hype. This kit has generous sample sizes, I got a minimum of three uses of each product and I have long thick hair. ( you REALLY don't need very much, just like they say). I ended up buying full sized product after trying. But the full sized product was too expensive for me to try and potentially not like. This would also be perfect for traveling.

I used this directly after bleaching and toning my hair. My hair has never felt this good period, let alone after putting it through chemical treatment!!!  I could tell as soon as i rinsed out the first two treatments it was going to be great because my hair felt amazing, as opposed to it feeling like the stringy dry noodles it felt like before trying this product. I’m buying the larger version as soon as my financials allow for it. Definitely try it out!!!

I followed the instructions on the bottles . First 0 on dry hair, , let process for 10 mins, after that put number 3 on top of that and let it process another 10-15 mins , I washed it out with the shampoo 4  and conditioner 5 also included. The pre-shampoo treatment is nothing short of a miracle. My hair is dyed and trying to find something to keep it healthy looking has been a challenge until I used this product.  The shampoo and conditioner were just okay- but the pre shampoo treatment made my hair look healthy like it was before I started dyeing it. I will purchase the pre-shampoo treatment again. Probably won't purchase the shampoo or conditioner since I didn't feel it was super moisturizing. Smells good though.

I got this so I could see if I liked the olaplex products.  I used all the products exactly how the instructions say and I think they made my hair look nicer than it did before I used it.  My husband also thought they made my hair look healthier and shinier.  I liked it enough that I will probably purchase the full sized products.

claims.text: Many reviewers find this kit a great, affordable way to try Olaplex, often getting multiple uses out of the sample sizes.
Reviewers frequently report that the products made their hair feel softer, healthier, and shinier, especially after damage or chemical treatment.
A few reviewers report problems with their orders, including missing items or opened and half-filled bottles.
Some reviewers mention the product is pricey, though others consider it a good value.
One reviewer reports severe hair loss after using the product.
